summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.92. Confirmed account takeover for s.demir@aegean.edu (lab-admin). All 8 sign-ins originated from a single foreign VPS (45.142.10.9, Cloudvault, Frankfurt, DE) via the flagged vulnerable VPN appliance vpn-edge-01, with no device_id recorded — inconsistent with normal lab-admin access. One MFA approval at 21:31 followed by seven consecutive successes with zero MFA prompts indicates session/token reuse after initial compromise, and the regular 5-minute alternating portal/LMS access pattern indicates automated activity rather than a human user. No explaining mail events or contextual signals exist to classify as benign, and the evidence is sufficient for containment rather than escalation.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
